risk_note: RV2 (platform/idempotency abandon route, BR-ID-10 abandon endpoint; 04 §6.1 / §5 / §3.2). The route only injects the subject from the token principal (uid, app_id), hands action / idempotency_key / trace to Idempotency.abandon and writes the IdempotentResponse out byte for byte (no re-serialisation); outcome_unknown is not caught and the global error filter drops the connection; the controller is always registered on the api entry (src/contract.test.ts: every implemented operation has a route on the database-less api entry) and fails closed with 50001 without IDEMPOTENCY; admin / stream do not mount it. Contract abandonIdempotencyKey leaves planned; route-schemas regenerated. The IDEMPOTENCY symbol moves to idempotency/token.ts and is re-exported by platform.module.ts. Conditional version gate / deletion_only scope / ban whitelist belong to B1-03c and the ban guard task (brief §9.2). Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
